name: comp-149
blurb: Circular weekday picker with checkboxes for each day.
description: Fieldset with 7 circular checkbox buttons representing weekdays. M-F pre-checked, Sunday disabled. Uses sr-only labels with visible first-letter abbreviations.
avoid_when: The circular button design may not work well on very small viewports.
a11y: Full fieldset with legend. Checkboxes hidden but accessible. Screen reader labels for full day names. Disabled Sunday indicated via disabled attribute.
